args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a single quick dagger thrust: a narrow bright horizontal piercing streak pointing to the right, a sharp needle-like tip flash with a small four-point star glint at the tip, thin silver-white core with a violet rim, a few tiny steel sparks scattering forward. Restrained version: compact size, fewer particles, small glow core, muted charcoal, silver and dusky violet colors, clean readable shape. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (smoke puffs, dust, pebbles, steel shards) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no silhouettes, no creatures, no weapons, no text, no letters, transparent background.
